objective: Turn existing Michigan and Great Lakes assets into a connected decision network while improving Boat Launches and Shipwrecks without thin URLs, search cannibalization, data overclaims, or active-experiment churn.

dimensions.definition: Safe hub pages expose crawlable task-based links into related tools and measure symbolic handoffs.
The existing 42-launch page becomes faster to search, filter, route and screen without pretending regional buoy data is ramp truth.
The existing wreck database gains useful filtering, presets, orientation mapping and factual consistency without inventing exact coordinates.
Preserve canonical ownership, entity signals, concise snippets and the existing record-rich parent URLs instead of creating thin children.
No safety inference, false spatial precision, geolocation, cookies, browser storage or fingerprinting.
Measure filters, decisions and cross-tool handoffs using stable first-party event names and non-personal symbolic metadata.

fatalPenalties: A new thin or competing launch/shipwreck URL is created without query evidence and substantial unique value.
A nearest NDBC station is presented as on-ramp, harbor-specific, or boating-safety truth.
A regional shipwreck anchor is presented as an exact wreck, navigation, or dive coordinate.
Either parent canonical changes or the 42-launch / 60-plus-wreck source inventory materially shrinks.
New code collects precise location, cookies, local/session storage, fingerprinting, or personal identifiers.
Protected active-experiment search surfaces or the unrelated Circle Tour agent branch are modified for this build.

outcomeTargets.principle: Build scores are merge gates, not traffic forecasts. Search Console and first-party behavior after a clean window are the market test.

boatLaunches.note: Target after enough comparable in-season impressions.

shipwrecks.note: First authority milestone; ranking depth matters more than snippet optimization at the current position.

network.goal: Increase multi-tool sessions without altering protected destination snippets.
